title: ASE: Attribution-Guided Semantic Evolution for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.23027v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: External text can supply predictive information absent from numerical histories, but its value depends on how it is represented, combined and deployed. We present Attribution-guided Semantic Evolution (ASE), a modular framework for constructing textual factors, evaluating their conditional contribution, and deploying validation-selected numerical--textual predictors. ASE supports task-specific implementations with lexical measurements, semantic primitives or evolved event/state factors, coupled to suitable numerical experts. Its feedback-based implementation uses conditional refitting diagnostics to guide factor revision and combination search. We evaluate ASE on the four text-associated TESS datasets and dynamic CSI 300 stock ranking. The four forecasting implementations obtain test MSEs of 0.001041, 0.022439, 0.333115 and 1.8150, each below the corresponding published TESS score. translated_title: ASE：面向时间序列预测的归因引导语义演化
translated_abstract: 外部文本能够提供数值历史数据中所缺失的预测信息，但其价值取决于如何对文本进行表示、组合与部署。我们提出了归因引导语义演化，这是一个模块化框架，用于构建文本因子、评估其条件贡献，并部署经验证集筛选的数值-文本联合预测器。ASE支持针对具体任务的实现方式，包括词汇度量、语义原语或演化生成的事件/状态因子，并将其与合适的数值专家模型相结合。其基于反馈的实现利用条件重拟合诊断来指导因子修订与组合搜索。我们在四个与文本相关的TESS数据集以及动态沪深300股票排名任务上评估了ASE。四种预测实现分别取得了0.001041、0.022439、0.333115和1.8150的测试MSE，均低于相应的已发表TESS最优分数。在沪深300上，冻结文本融合实现（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了归因引导语义演化（ASE）模块化框架，通过归因反馈机制自动构建、评估和演化文本因子并与数值模型融合，在TESS文本时间序列基准和沪深300动态股票排名上均超越了已发表的最优结果。
